statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
The symptoms are consistent with supraventricular tachycardia
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) was ordered
The service is to capture intermittent arrhythmic events and correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances over an extended monitoring period
The diagnosis codes are I47.1 and I25.10
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial is based on required precertification or authorization not being obtained prior to the service date
